decision.reason: T1->T2 rescue improves old-entry economics and preserves a high-quality strong cohort. T2->T3 is negative in both research and fresh and concentrates severe/non-target loss. T3 source-switch has 4/4 non-target and -$8.48. T1->T3 loses substantial value versus old entry but still carries six strong winners and is near flat after rescue, so blanket removal is not justified yet.

drop_T2_TO_T3_plus_T3_SOURCE_SWITCH.warning: Diagnostic only; removes 1 research + 4 fresh strong winners from T2->T3. CT5B must test exact architecture and retention.
